stations: 65 Luas stops across the Red and Green Lines (Connolly and Saggart excluded - no real-time coverage in the NTA feed, see notCovered).
notes: Abbey Street is the Red Line hub; the Green Line interchange (Marlborough / O'Connell - GPO / O'Connell Upper) is a short walk away, not the same stop. Connolly (Red trunk, between George's Dock and Busaras) and Saggart (Red Line branch terminus) are filtered out of v1: the live NTA GTFS-RT v2 TripUpdates feed never carries a stopTimeUpdate for either stop's static stop_ids, confirmed against multiple live polls during Dublin Sunday daytime service (Connolly: 27 Sep 2026, three polls; Saggart: 27 Sep 2026, 20/20 polls over 15 min plus a further 6/6-poll corroboration, both against Fortunestown/Citywest Campus controls carrying 2-6 trips every poll on the same branch) - real trips' own live stopTimeUpdate arrays skip straight past these stops, omitting their slots entirely, while both neighbouring stops resolve correctly under their own stop_ids. The 'Red + Saggart' direction chip still appears at every upstream Red stop (Saggart is still a valid printed terminus, per lib/cities/dublin/marketing-directions.js's LINE_TERMINI list, independent of catalog/board membership) - only Saggart's own board is filtered, not the destination it names. Per docs/board-eligibility-rule.md, a station with no confirmable real-time service is filtered out of the app rather than shown with a silently empty board. Some stops - including Luas termini such as Broombridge - can go 10+ minutes without a live prediction while the tram is genuinely running: the NTA feed intermittently omits a stop's live data for a stretch, then resumes; the app says so (a clear on-screen message) rather than showing a blank board, and the stop stays in the app rather than being filtered, because it is confirmed to work at other times the same day (see docs/dublin-d1/live-sweep-log.jsonl, the evidence log qa/dublin-all-stations-live-sweep.mjs uses to tell this apart from a permanent gap like Connolly/Saggart above). This covers Red Cow, Kylemore, Marlborough, Rialto and Broombridge, all confirmed non-empty earlier or later the same day (27 Sep 2026) despite one sweep run seeing them continuously empty.
